interpretation: Continuous sequence descriptors; exploratory overlays, not independent validation of the embedding.

series.interpretation_limits: An independent-site sequence model, not a surface potential or PTM-aware experimental charge.
series.label: Net electric charge at specified pH

series.interpretation_limits: Defined only for a unique zero crossing in the stated titration interval; predicted and measured pI remain separate.
series.label: Isoelectric point

series.interpretation_limits: Composition only; excludes histidine and is not actual net charge.
series.label: Basic-residue fraction

series.interpretation_limits: Composition only; not the acidity of a solution.
series.label: Acidic-residue fraction

series.interpretation_limits: Neutral-pH compositional convention; equals B03+B04 and is not independent of them.
series.label: Fraction of charged residues

series.interpretation_limits: SCD, not kappa. Mathematically zero without charged pairs. Conformational interpretation is IDR-specific; depends on sequence length.
series.label: Sequence charge decoration

parameters.name: applicability
parameters.value: charge arrangement; conformational interpretation is IDR-specific

parameters.name: charges
parameters.value: K,R=+1; D,E=-1; others=0; no terminal charges

series.interpretation_limits: Higher values are more hydrophobic on this scale; no inferred solubility or categorical cutoff.
series.label: Mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy

series.interpretation_limits: A whole-scope compositional statistic, not a SEG call, disorder predictor, or order-sensitive complexity measure. No low-complexity cutoff.
series.label: Shannon sequence entropy

parameters.name: scope
parameters.value: whole analyzed sequence; no low-complexity cutoff

series.interpretation_limits: Predictor, version, mode, full input sequence hash and score-source hash are required. Predicted disorder is distinct from observed disorder.
series.label: Predicted disordered fraction and segments
